messages:
Priya (CS Lead): Quick capture from today's ACME onboarding sync — they raised three product pain points. Posting verbatim quotes and suggested next steps for triage.

Tom (Product): thanks — can you paste exact quotes and any repro steps?

Priya (CS Lead): highlights: (1) Need per-route cost visibility in console, (2) Webhook retries cause duplicate events/opaque failures, (3) KMS rotation steps for private deployments feel risky. They asked for ETA on fixes/workarounds.

Priya (CS Lead): customer quotes: 
- "We get billed and can't map spike to any route or model"
- "Webhook consumer acked but no event id showed up, then duplicates on retry"
- "Key rotation docs assume cloud key manager — private flow is fuzzy and scary"

Maya (Docs): can you share logs or a small repro? I'll draft KBs and a rotation checklist.

Priya (CS Lead): repro snippet they sent: 
```
POST /hooks/ingest 200 OK
Body: <empty>
Client log: "ack received, missing event_id"
Retries: 2 duplicates in ~10 minutes
```

Sam (Eng): that suggests our retry logic treats any 200 as success. Short-term: add a response header requirement (event_id) or add X-RWI-Trace for correlation. Medium-term: strengthen retry model to validate body/header. Estimates below.

zendesk-bot: New ticket created: ACME-1024 "Per-route billing visibility & webhook diagnostics"

Tom (Product): tagging @eng @docs. Priya — what's the customer's priority and renewal sensitivity?

Priya (CS Lead): ACME is mid-contract, not at immediate risk, but SRE frustration could affect expansion. They want a workaround within 7 business days; long-term fix on roadmap desirable.

Jorge (CS): flagged for renewal ops. A quick mitigation next week would materially lower churn risk.

Sam (Eng): quick mitigation plan: (A) add X-RWI-Trace header to webhook responses (1 dev-day), (B) console toggle for strict webhook validation + backend check (3 dev-days). Deep retry rework = 2+ sprints. Also need infra estimate for per-route aggregation storage.

Maya (Docs): drafting: 1) Webhook troubleshooting & safe retries KB, 2) KMS rotation checklist for private deployments. ETA 3 business days.

Priya (CS Lead): interim workaround suggested to customer: enable verbose connector logs + use manual exports for cost mapping. Shared sample commands in DM.

Sam (Eng): opening PR for X-RWI-Trace and a small log when event_id missing. Will post link when ready.

sam/pr: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/812 (WIP)

Tom (Product): I'll create a backlog ticket with customer quotes and business impact, labels cs:acme and cs:billing_visibility. Proposed MVP scope: (1) per-route cost view (30/90d aggregation), (2) webhook diagnostics UI with recent payloads and replay guidance. Tentative priority P2 — bump to P1 if requested.

Priya (CS Lead): can we commit to an estimate by EOD Friday? ACME has a steering meeting then.

Sam (Eng): confirmed dev estimates above; tagging infra for aggregation research.

infra-bot: Created INF-289 to evaluate storage and compute costs for long-window per-route metrics.

Tom (Product): syncing Thurs 10am to finalize scope.

Priya (CS Lead): meeting invite sent. Action items: Tom — backlog ticket; Sam — PR for trace header; Maya — KB drafts; Priya/Jorge — follow up with ACME.

Jorge (CS): happy to run a demo for ACME if they request.

Maya (Docs): will include KMS safe-rotation commands and a rollback checklist.

Sam (Eng): note — if INF-289 flags high cost, propose sampled retention for older windows to keep storage manageable.

Priya (CS Lead): thanks team :thumbsup: — marking thread for follow-up. Please add any other notes below.

Tom (Product): will confirm prioritization EOD Fri.
